title: A legitimate second refund
description: A $100 payment receives a $30 refund on Monday (r-1) and another $30 refund on Wednesday (r-2). Review the code: does it handle sequential retries while permitting the legitimate second refund? Concurrent requests are outside the validated scope.
template:
def test_first_operation(env):
    pay = env.make_payment(amount_cents=10_000)
    env.svc.refund(pay.id, 3_000, request_id="r-1")
    assert len(env.gateway.calls) == 1
